entries: Gouraah! Shiny rocks make light. Children toy. Scaphin no need. Humans want for power. Scaphin power not come from this.
咕啦！亮石头会发光。小孩的玩具。斯卡芬不需要。人类想要力量。斯卡芬的力量不来自这东西。
Strong! Like Scaphin warrior! Before warriors turn...
强壮！像斯卡芬，的战士！在战士们都堕落之前……
Things die, mushrooms return things to dirt.
东西会死，蘑菇把东西还给泥土。
Humans grow weak, make room for Scaphin. Caves home of Scaphin. Scaphin rule caves. Soon, Scaphin will live in human homes? No, too dry.
人类变弱，给斯卡芬腾地方。洞穴是斯卡芬的家。斯卡芬统治洞穴。不久，斯卡芬要住进人类的房子？不，太干。

Caves go up, caves go down. Caves go in, caves go out. Everywhere caves.

Evil power lives here now. Scaphin must flee or turn. Made by dark lord.

洞穴向上，洞穴向下。洞穴向内，洞穴向外。到处都是洞穴。

邪恶的力量如今住在这里。斯卡芬要么逃走，要么堕落。黑暗领主，造的。
You? No more business with human!
Blue rock. Trade with Goblin or Human. Once trade. No longer. Human now stupid. Goblin too mean.
蓝石头。和哥布林，或人类交易。曾经交易。如今不了。人类现在蠢了。哥布林太刻薄。
Scaaagghhh!!! Scaphin no like. Will not share the wet places.
嘶——啊！！！斯卡芬不喜欢。潮湿的地方，绝不分享。
Son is #. Want wear human cloth. Can such be king? Prove worth. You take. Return worthy son.
儿子是 #。想穿人类的布。这样能当国王？证明价值。你们带上他。带着有价值的人回来。
Son. Prove worth. Scaphin need strength. Return worthy, or no return.
儿子。证明价值。斯卡芬，需要力量。带着价值回来，否则别回来。
Scagh! Goblins... small Scaphin. Squishy. Mean and make noise. Scaphin big, but Goblins many.
嘶咔！哥布林……小小的斯卡芬。软塌塌。刻薄，还吵。斯卡芬大，可哥布林多。
I warn not to go. Human not listen. Lucky to escape. Is pretty stone worth death?
我警告过别去。人类不听。能逃出来算走运。漂亮的石头值得拿命换吗？
Human... female? No no. Human male.
人类……母的？不不。人类公的。
Tree skin block. Is it pillow? Scaphin not understand this human thing.
树皮的方块。是枕头吗？斯卡芬不懂人类这东西。
Underground always wet. Air thick. Good for lungs.
地下总是潮湿。空气厚。对肺好。
I lead Scaphin. Raise son. Enjoy bath. Conquer Manshroom.
我带领斯卡芬。养育儿子。享受沐浴。征服人菇。
Human seem different. Other humans fading.
人类看着不一样。别的人类在褪色。
What is chin hair purpose? Upsidedown head?
下巴的毛有什么用？脑袋长倒了？
Deep evil put by dark lord. Evil come to Scaphin. Evil come to all living. Unliving too. It remake. It remake mushroom into Manshroom. Manshroom take caves from Scaphin.
深层的邪恶，黑暗领主，放下的。邪恶来到斯卡芬这里。邪恶来到一切活物。死物也一样。它重塑。它把蘑菇重造成人菇。人菇，夺走斯卡芬的洞穴。
Sometimes make weapon. Need many fire. Scaphin like wet. Fire not like wet.
有时造武器。需要很多火。斯卡芬，喜欢潮湿。火不喜欢潮湿。
Long time gone. Make Scaphin go war. We free, for short. Now evil come back. Make Scaphin hate. Make Scaphin want blood. Scaphin cannot win.
过去很久了。让斯卡芬，去打战。我们自由了，短暂地。如今邪恶回来了。让斯卡芬，满怀憎恨。让斯卡芬，渴望鲜血。斯卡芬，赢不了。
Blue like corundum. Fly like Helioon. What is it?
蓝色，像刚玉。会飞，像赫利翁。它是什么？
What is speaking meat!? Is it evil?
会说话的肉是什么！？是邪恶吗？
Scaphin no take. Scaphin fill. You leave empty, we fill. Sometimes kill for make space, mostly wait.
斯卡芬不拿。斯卡芬补齐。你们留下空的，我们填上。有时杀腾地方，大多时候等。
Keh? Too many strange human word.
咳？太多奇怪的人类词了。
What this noise? Is speaking? Make want to sleep. Gentle speaking...
这声音是什么？是在说话？让人想睡。轻柔的说话声……
